pattern: ^; it does not carry forward: \(a\) its commit is not an ancestor of the head$
why: The owner's ruling on #474 (2026-11-18): a CLOSED lens at an earlier head may carry forward. delivery.py refused any older marker outright; mhw delivery tries the carry-forward first and, when it fails, keeps the original message and adds the condition that failed.
The carry-forward's condition (a) asks git whether the marker's commit is an ancestor of the head; delivery.py had no carry-forward and made no such call.

Lens round 1 on PR #508: git quotes a non-ASCII path by default, so delivery.py's newline list could hide a harness path from the hold-2 trigger. mhw delivery reads the list NUL-separated with -z, which quotes nothing; the call is otherwise the same.

pattern: ^PENDING: the newest agents-lead lens marker is not in the strict header format$
why: Lens round 1 on PR #508: the newest lens marker is selected by any column-0 envelope line outside a fence, as the quality-assurance brief selects it, so a newer marker below a preamble still withdraws an older CLOSED one. This marker is then refused for its format, where delivery.py refused it as absent. Both refuse.

pattern: ^PENDING: the newest agents-lead lens marker is not in the strict header format$
why: The same selector: a ~~~ line opens a fence and the ``` line inside it toggles it, as the brief's own fence rule reads it, so the marker line counts as outside a fence and is then refused for its format. delivery.py refused it as absent. Both refuse.
